{{Quote|Cooha<br />System: Gandeid. The tall, lanky Gandeidan cooha is well adapted to the low gravity of Gandeid IV, where it feeds primarily on flightless noli nestlings.|Personal notes of Wilek Nereus|<ref name="TTaBS" />}}
'''Gandeid IV''' was the primary [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Gandeid system/Legends|Gandeid system]],<ref name="CSWE" /> a part of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Trailing Grant sector/Legends|Trailing Grant sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The planet occupied the fourth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position in its [[Star system/Legends|star system]], and the Gandeidan [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] was low and the climate [[Temperature/Legends|temperate]].<ref name="CSWE" /> It was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Species/Legends|creatures]] known as [[noli]] as well as the large [[Diet/Legends|predatory]] [[Bird/Legends|avian]] [[cooha]].<ref name="TTaBS" />

At some point before his [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Wilek Nereus]] of the<ref name="TTaBS" /> [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="EAOC Bakura">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Bakura system/Legends|Bakura system]]</ref> planet [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] visited Gandeid IV, where he obtained several cooha [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] to add to his dental [[Collector/Legends|collection]]. Nereus included a mention of the planet in an entry of his personal notes dedicated to the cooha.<ref name="TTaBS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gandeid IV was first mentioned in ''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]'', a [[1996]] sourcebook published for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TTaBS" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Gandeid system, and therefore Gandeid IV, in grid square J-15.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
